package toolvolume

// Generator of testdata/go-oracle-advisorydb.json (TypeScript port, ticket
// 19). The Go code is frozen, so this file is kept as text: copy it to
// internal/toolvolume/zz_oracle_advisorydb_test.go, run
//
//	go test ./internal/toolvolume -run TestZZOracleAdvisoryDB -count=1
//
// and delete the copy. It records, with a fake docker CLI, every argument
// list that EnsureAdvisoryDB passes to the docker CLI (download, reuse,
// failed refresh with and without an old database), its progress lines and
// errors, and what parseDBDate and needsRefresh make of date files.

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/docker"
)

type advisoryOracleCase struct {
	Name      string     `json:"name"`
	Mode      string     `json:"mode"`
	Date      string     `json:"date"`
	Now       string     `json:"now"`
	Error     string     `json:"error"`
	Result    string     `json:"result"`
	Logs      []string   `json:"logs"`
	Calls     [][]string `json:"calls"`
	FileTypes []string   `json:"fileTypes"`
}

// The fake answers `volume inspect` with the label osv-db, the probe with the
// date in DATE (exit 1 when DATE is empty), and the clear, download and swap
// containers with exit 0, unless MODE names the step that fails: clear,
// download (exit 2), vulns (exit 1, which is no failure) or swap.
const advisoryOracleScript = `#!/bin/sh
for a in "$@"; do printf '%s\037' "$a"; done >> "$(dirname "$0")/calls"
printf '\036' >> "$(dirname "$0")/calls"
case "$1 $2" in
  "volume inspect") echo osv-db; exit 0 ;;
esac
case "$1" in
  inspect)
    case "$*" in
      *advisorydb-probe*) if [ -z "$DATE" ]; then echo '{"ExitCode":1,"OOMKilled":false}'; exit 0; fi ;;
      *advisorydb-clear*) if [ "$MODE" = clear ]; then echo '{"ExitCode":1,"OOMKilled":false}'; exit 0; fi ;;
      *advisorydb-download*) if [ "$MODE" = download ]; then echo '{"ExitCode":2,"OOMKilled":false}'; exit 0; fi
        if [ "$MODE" = vulns ]; then echo '{"ExitCode":1,"OOMKilled":false}'; exit 0; fi ;;
      *advisorydb-swap*) if [ "$MODE" = swap ]; then echo '{"ExitCode":1,"OOMKilled":false}'; exit 0; fi ;;
    esac
    echo '{"ExitCode":0,"OOMKilled":false}' ;;
  start)
    case "$*" in
      *advisorydb-probe*) printf '%s' "$DATE" ;;
      *advisorydb-clear*) if [ "$MODE" = clear ]; then echo 'rm: cannot remove' >&2; fi ;;
      *advisorydb-download*) if [ "$MODE" = download ]; then printf 'one\ntwo\nthree\nfour: no route to host\n' >&2; fi ;;
      *advisorydb-swap*) if [ "$MODE" = swap ]; then echo 'mv: cannot stat' >&2; fi ;;
    esac ;;
esac
exit 0
`

func TestZZOracleAdvisoryDB(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	start := time.Date(2026, 10, 26, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	cases := []struct{ name, mode, date string; now time.Time }{
		{"no database: download", "", "", start},
		{"no database: the scanner finds vulnerabilities in the seed", "vulns", "", start.Add(500 * time.Millisecond)},
		{"a database of 23 hours: reuse", "", "2026-10-26T09:00:00Z", start.Add(23 * time.Hour)},
		{"a database of exactly 24 hours: reuse", "", "2026-10-26T09:00:00Z\n", start.Add(24*time.Hour + 999*time.Millisecond)},
		{"a database of 25 hours: refresh", "", "2026-10-26T09:00:00Z", start.Add(25 * time.Hour)},
		{"a refresh that cannot download keeps the old database", "download", "2026-10-26T09:00:00Z", start.Add(25 * time.Hour)},
		{"a refresh that cannot clear keeps the old database", "clear", "2026-10-26T09:00:00Z", start.Add(25 * time.Hour)},
		{"a refresh that cannot swap keeps the old database", "swap", "2026-10-26T09:00:00Z", start.Add(25 * time.Hour)},
		{"without a database a failed download is an error", "download", "", start},
		{"a date nobody can read: download", "", "yesterday", start},
		{"a date in the future: download", "", "2026-10-27T09:00:00Z", start},
		{"a date with an offset", "", "2026-10-26T11:00:00+02:00", start.Add(time.Hour)},
	}
	var out []advisoryOracleCase
	for _, c := range cases {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "docker"), []byte(advisoryOracleScript), 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		env := []string{"PATH=/usr/bin:/bin", "MODE=" + c.mode, "DATE=" + c.date}
		d := docker.New(filepath.Join(dir, "docker"), env).WithScope(docker.Scope{RunID: "RUN", Host: "h", PID: 1, Deadline: time.Unix(0, 0).UTC()})
		oc := advisoryOracleCase{Name: c.name, Mode: c.mode, Date: c.date, Now: c.now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), Logs: []string{}}
		logf := func(format string, args ...any) {
			oc.Logs = append(oc.Logs, strings.ReplaceAll(fmt.Sprintf(format, args...), dir, "<cache>"))
		}
		now := c.now
		db, err := EnsureAdvisoryDB(ctx, AdvisoryConfig{
			Docker: d, CacheDir: filepath.Join(dir, "cache"), Scanner: "osv@sha256:scanner", Helper: "alpine@sha256:helper",
			Now: func() time.Time { return now }, Logf: logf,
		})
		if err != nil {
			oc.Error = strings.ReplaceAll(err.Error(), dir, "<cache>")
		} else {
			oc.Result = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s refreshed=%v warning=%q", db.Name, db.Date.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), db.Refreshed, db.Warning)
		}
		data, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "calls"))
		for _, call := range strings.Split(string(data), "\x1e") {
			if call == "" {
				continue
			}
			parts := strings.Split(call, "\x1f")
			oc.Calls = append(oc.Calls, parts[:len(parts)-1])
		}
		out = append(out, oc)
	}

	type dateCase struct {
		In           string `json:"in"`
		OK           bool   `json:"ok"`
		UTC          string `json:"utc"`
		NeedsRefresh bool   `json:"needsRefresh"`
	}
	var dates []dateCase
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 26, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, in := range []string{
		"2026-10-26T11:00:00Z", "2026-10-25T12:00:00Z", "2026-10-25T11:59:59Z", "2026-10-19T12:00:00Z", "", "yesterday",
		"2026-10-27T12:00:00Z", " 2026-10-26T11:00:00Z\n", "2026-10-26T11:00:00.5Z", "2026-10-26T11:00:00,25Z",
		"2026-10-26T11:00:00.123456789Z", "2026-10-26t11:00:00Z", "2026-10-26T11:00:00z", "2026-10-26 11:00:00Z",
		"2026-10-26T9:00:00Z", "2026-10-26T11:00:00+02:00", "2026-10-26T11:00:00-02:30", "2026-10-26T11:00:00+24:00",
		"2026-10-26T11:00:00+2:00", "2026-10-26T24:00:00Z", "2026-10-26T11:60:00Z", "2026-10-26T11:00:60Z",
		"2026-02-29T11:00:00Z", "2024-02-29T11:00:00Z", "2026-13-01T11:00:00Z", "2026-00-01T11:00:00Z", "0099-10-26T11:00:00Z",
		"2026-10-26T11:00:00", "2026-10-26T11:00Z", "+2026-10-26T11:00:00Z", "2026-10-26T11:00:00.Z", "2026-10-26T11:00:00Z ",
		"\u00852026-10-26T11:00:00Z", "2026-10-26T11:00:00+25:00", "2026-10-26T11:00:00+24:59", "2026-10-26T11:00:00+23:60", "2026-10-26T11:00:00+23:61", "2026-10-26T011:00:00Z", "2026-1-26T11:00:00Z", "2026-10-26T11:0:00Z", "2026-10-26T11:00:00+0200", "2026-10-26T11:00:00.1234567891234Z",
	} {
		d, ok := parseDBDate(in)
		c := dateCase{In: in, OK: ok, NeedsRefresh: needsRefresh(d, now)}
		if ok {
			c.UTC = d.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
		}
		dates = append(dates, c)
	}

	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
		"note":         "docker CLI argument lists, progress lines and errors of toolvolume.EnsureAdvisoryDB with a fake CLI (scope RUN, host h, pid 1, deadline the Unix epoch), and parseDBDate/needsRefresh at 2026-10-26T12:00:00Z",
		"cases":        out,
		"dates":        dates,
	}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/go-oracle-advisorydb.json", append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
